brief: Two pairs of bases for a shared desk, each pair one body, the pairs joined only by a side connector so they can be split later.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full touch bare wall 0,0|1,0, topology groups them as [0,0 1,0] one body; same for pair 2 (piece:2,0,0;full + piece:3,0,0;full, group [2,0 3,0]). Full covers on all four give shared desk top.
requirements.requirement: Two pairs of bases for a shared desk, each pair one body

requirements.evidence: Wall 1,0|2,0 carries connector:0#1,0|2,0 (side-connector-single); no other connector; topology shows two groups joined only there, so removing it splits the desk. check_build ok, meshClash clear.
requirements.requirement: Pairs joined only by a side connector so they can be split later

finish.summary: 4 full bases in a row 0,0-3,0 with covers: bare walls inside each pair make two one-body pairs; a single side connector between 1,0 and 2,0 is the only join, removable to split. Capped, locked, keyboard + 2 mugs dressed, checks clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-single  (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Two desk halves that split apart — I'll lay out the linked bases.

Structure's verified — now staging it as a shared desk.
